title: IR sensor still: elongated dark object with trail, Iraq 2022
description: Second infrared sensor frame from the Iraq 2022 unresolved UAP report: a dark elongated object with a faint motion trail appears in the upper right, with the targeting crosshair mid-frame, corner fiducials, 1.4a/1.4g redaction boxes, USCENTCOM MDR footer and 'Approved for Release to AARO – FOUO' marking.
